# Middle Class Musicians

> Middle Class Musicians (MCM Studio) is a recording and music production studio in Uttam Nagar, New Delhi, India.

## Canonical website

- https://middleclassmusicians.in/

## Core services

- Vocal recording
- Mixing and mastering
- Custom beat production
- Songwriting and arrangement support
- Music production and AI music courses

## Useful pages

- Studio: https://middleclassmusicians.in/studio

- Audio portfolio with Raw/Final comparisons: https://middleclassmusicians.in/portfolio
- Music production articles and community discussion: https://middleclassmusicians.in/blogs
- Courses: https://middleclassmusicians.in/courses
